hooks.command: sh -c 'for d in "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null)" "$PWD"; do f="$d/scripts/hooks/guard_writes.py"; [ -n "$d" ] && [ -f "$f" ] && exec python3 "$f"; done; exit 0'
sh -c 'for d in "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null)" "$PWD"; do f="$d/scripts/hooks/stop_check.py"; [ -n "$d" ] && [ -f "$f" ] && exec python3 "$f"; done; exit 0'
